subject: general
question: Pick the odd one out.
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44f9c5b01d23e1f5b0ea1b76279418cff42a62e04d9bbf601c0460da03804998.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

1. MNKL → M + 1 = N; N – 3 = K; K + 1 = L

2. IJGH → I + 1 = J; J – 3 = G; G + 1 = H

3. EFCD → E + 1 = F; F – 3 = C; C + 1 = D

**4. OPQR → O + 1 = P; P + 1 = Q; Q + 1 = R**

Hence, ‘**OPQR**’ is the odd one out.
